system.effect:
You learn this fighting style. Use your Melee Proficiency for its checks and Attacks unless a technique specifies another check. Each Talent here contributes to your Melee rank. You gain the Overreach action.

Overreach ❶ Stance
You must be wielding a two-handed melee weapon.

While you are in this stance your Hits and Critical Hits deal +2 damage and your Evade drops by 2, rising to +3 damage at Expert rank, +4 at Master, and +5 at Legendary. Every talent here requires this.
